company.name: Watermelon Ecosystem
company.shortDescription: Watermelon Market is a SaaS company that supplies an ordering platform created for food and beverage buyers and sellers.
company.description: Watermelon Ecosystem is a UAE-based food and beverage procurement and business management platform that connects restaurants, hotels, caterers, and suppliers through a digital marketplace. The company provides tools for supplier sourcing, order and invoice management, cloud-based POS systems, financing support, analytics, and marketing services tailored to the HORECA industry. Its platform is designed to streamline procurement workflows, improve supply chain coordination, and support local sourcing initiatives within the F&B sector.
